# SDK & Service Architecture Requirements Checklist: Unified TypeScript and Dart SDK Contracts

**Purpose**: Validate that specification requirements define a clean, well-organized, and maintainable design across the backend service (`kalamdb-*`) and SDK layers (`link-common`, WASM, FRB, TypeScript, Dart) before and during implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [app-readiness.md](../app-readiness.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command as "Unit Tests for Requirements" targeting SDK + service design boundaries, single-authority contracts, and maintainability.

## Crate, Package & Ownership Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 Are ownership boundaries between `kalamdb-serialization`, `kalamdb-api`, `link-common`, WASM/FRB bridges, and target-language SDK packages explicitly specified without circular dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-050, Plan §Owners]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification prohibit heavy server dependencies (Arrow, DataFusion, RocksDB, HTTP server, V8) from leaking into the lean shared codec core used by client builds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-050, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK003 Are TypeScript and Dart package responsibilities separated so function-only consumers do not pull in ORM, local persistence (`kalam_sync`/Drift), or UI framework dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract: public-api.md §1–§2]
- [x] CHK004 Is the boundary between remote Dart table queries (`kalam_link`) and local SQLite persistence (`kalam_sync` single Drift connection) unambiguously defined? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-035, §FR-036]
- [x] CHK005 Are external protocol/storage formats (PGWire, Parquet, Arrow, RocksDB, tonic transport) clearly distinguished from KalamDB-owned domain-value serialization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053, §FR-056, Plan §Release policy]

## Single Authority & Schema-First Contract Design

- [x] CHK006 Is a single semantic authority specified for SQL logical types, keys, nullability, defaults, parameter modes, and routine overloads across server and both SDK emitters? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK007 Are deterministic identifier normalization, collision resolution, and exact SQL-to-public name mapping rules specified so TS and Dart generators cannot diverge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract: public-api.md §2]
- [x] CHK008 Does the specification require generated target-language codecs to delegate binary encoding/decoding to the shared Rust core rather than maintaining independent TS/Dart binary parsers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-048, Contract: public-api.md §1, §3]
- [x] CHK009 Are staged multi-root code generation and atomic manifest publication requirements defined so failed generation preserves existing working application files? [Recovery, Spec §FR-028, Data Model §8, Contract: public-api.md §10]
- [x] CHK010 Is the clean-break epoch policy consistently specified across API facades, wire framing, local sync schemas, and server storage without contradictory legacy alias or fallback requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, §FR-052, §FR-061]

## Cross-Language Type, Nullability & Error Semantics

- [x] CHK011 Are exact scalar mappings for 32/64-bit integers, `NUMERIC`/decimals, local dates/times, `TIMESTAMPTZ`, binary bytes, and `FILE` references specified for both TypeScript and Dart? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-040, Contract: public-api.md §9]
- [x] CHK012 Does the specification clearly distinguish omitted input/patch fields, SQL `NULL`, JSON `null`, empty result sets, and `VOID` across all RPC, table, and live boundaries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040, Contract: protocol.md §4]
- [x] CHK013 Are cardinality semantics (`get`, `getOne`, `getOptional`, scalar/set/void routines) and their failure conditions unambiguously defined for both SDKs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Contract: public-api.md §3]
- [x] CHK014 Are structured error payloads—including stable error codes, field/index paths, request/operation correlation IDs, and retry/uncertainty dispositions—specified across HTTP, WS, and native execution? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-069, §FR-074, Contract: protocol.md §4]

## Service Execution, RPC & Security Boundaries

- [x] CHK015 Does the specification require generated routine invocations to bind immutable descriptors directly to `FunctionService::invoke` without synthesizing `SELECT`/`CALL` SQL text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, Contract: protocol.md §5]
- [x] CHK016 Are in-process nested routine call requirements specified for permission frames (`EXECUTE`, `INVOKER`/`DEFINER`, RLS), shared root transaction/deadline/cancellation, and owned value passing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041, §FR-043, Contract: public-api.md §4]
- [x] CHK017 Are endpoint message-kind allowlists specified so valid internal Raft or persistence frames cannot be accepted on public HTTP RPC or WebSocket endpoints? [Security, Spec §FR-051, Contract: protocol.md §3]
- [x] CHK018 Are pre-allocation and parsing-time resource budgets (wire size, decompressed size, element count including null/zero-sized items, recursion depth, traversal work, retained buffers) quantified or bounded in the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §FR-049, §FR-057, Contract: serialization-performance.md §6]
- [x] CHK019 Does the specification prohibit client-supplied wire fields from overriding server-resolved principals, tenants, origins, transactions, or host capabilities? [Security, Spec §FR-031, Contract: protocol.md §3, §5]
- [x] CHK020 Are multi-organization authorization requirements defined so tenant/role membership is enforced server-side rather than relying on client organization selectors or `USER` partitioning alone? [Security, App Readiness §FR-065, Contract: application-development.md §5]

## Live Queries, WebSocket & Local Sync Lifecycle

- [x] CHK021 Are live query state transitions (`SnapshotBegin`, `SnapshotBatch`, `SnapshotEnd`, `Changes`, `Reset`, `Failure`) and explicit snapshot completion semantics specified independently of socket connectivity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013, Contract: protocol.md §6]
- [x] CHK022 Are subscription deduplication and lease-sharing rules scoped by account, query, projection, codec, and authorization so disposing one listener never disconnects active peers or leaks across accounts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-023, Contract: public-api.md §6]
- [x] CHK023 Are the four distinct sizing concepts—one-shot SQL `LIMIT`, live presentation window, snapshot batch size, and retained memory capacity—defined without conflating client memory caps with true server top-N windows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, App Readiness §FR-067, Contract: public-api.md §6]
- [x] CHK024 Are authoritative idempotency receipt requirements (principal/tenant, operation revision, canonical input digest before volatile default evaluation, atomic effect+receipt commit, expiry detection after pruning) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-021, Contract: protocol.md §7]
- [x] CHK025 Are Dart local durability transaction boundaries specified for inbox receipt, same-Drift projection, optimistic overlay stacking, worker lease fencing, and foreign-database projection receipts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017–§FR-024, Data Model §5–§7]

## Application Experience, SSR & Operational Maintainability

- [x] CHK026 Are server-rendered TypeScript (SSR) requirements specified for request-scoped client/auth/cache isolation and scoped hydration frontier handoff vs. provisional refetch? [Completeness, App Readiness §FR-066, Contract: application-development.md §6]
- [x] CHK027 Are UI mutation state requirements specified to track concurrent overlapping mutations on the same key per invocation rather than clearing shared pending state on the first completion? [Clarity, App Readiness §FR-068, Contract: application-development.md §8]
- [x] CHK028 Are non-atomic failure windows between external object/file storage or external webhooks/jobs and database transactions explicitly required to be surfaced rather than hidden behind pseudo-atomic abstractions? [Consistency, App Readiness §FR-070, §FR-071, Contract: application-development.md §9–§10]
- [x] CHK029 Are per-surface database guarantees (statement atomicity, isolation level, single-data-Raft-group boundaries, hot/cold flush invariance, current-format backup restore frontier) required to be declared and matched to test oracles (`DB-01`..`DB-20`)? [Measurability, App Readiness §FR-075–§FR-078, Contract: database-stability.md §1, §3]
- [x] CHK030 Are performance and codec selection gates (`Gate D`, `Gate R`) specified with pre-registered workloads, equivalent-semantics baselines, and explicit non-regression thresholds rather than assumed binary speedups? [Measurability, Spec §FR-055, §FR-059, §FR-062, Contract: serialization-performance.md §2–§4]
